data.name: Found
data.detailed_description:
Found is a narrative adventure game full of stories, puzzles, and a chance to rebuild a fragmented world. 

Explore a dreamlike soft-poly world that's been torn apart. As Em, a cloaked wanderer with glowing eyes, you'll uncover lost memories, wander through landscapes rich with puzzles, battle unfriendly creatures, and piece the world back together one fragment at a time.

Reassemble a world broken apart

Explore the world to collect fragments that can be pieced together to construct a map that's completely unique to your playthrough. As the world becomes whole, new places, people, puzzles, stories, and sidequests emerge, allowing you to gradually shape both the world and your journey through it.


Explore a world designed for discovery

Discover more than 200 unique levels and the stories and puzzles that tie them together. Unlock new abilities and revisit familiar places from new perspectives.

Discover unforgettable characters

Meet characters and cultures of all types, each with their own quirks and takes on what's happened to the world around them.

Grow your abilities

Manipulate the world by exploding walls, growing plants, disappearing from sight, and lighting the darkness. Combine what you've learned to uncover new places and pieces of the past.

Battle curious creatures

To progress through the landscapes of Found, you'll need to battle the enemies that rose up during the fragmentation. Boss battles are as much a test of your thinking as they are of fighting skills.

Uncover a familiar past

Recover memories and histories scattered across the world to understand who you are and to uncover the events that led to the Fragmentation.

data.short_description: Found is a narrative adventure about memory, identity, and rebuilding a fragmented world. Explore dreamlike soft-poly landscapes, uncover lost memories, solve environmental puzzles, battle curious creatures, and assemble a map unique to your journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X / Intel HD 520)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a Vulkan-capable GPU. Full controller support; keyboard and mouse fully rebindable.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 compatible GPU with 4 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1) or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (integrated Apple/Intel graphics supported)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Universal binary — runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Notarized by Apple.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1) or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU or discrete AMD GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Universal binary — runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Notarized by Apple.
